newsitems.title: [School-Wide Announcement] Worst Class Ever Demo Is Coming to an End
newsitems.author: heye
newsitems.contents: Dear Teachers and Students,Ding-ding-ding! Class is over!The Demo for Worst Class Ever will soon conclude its run and be officially taken down on November 3.Since the Demo launched, we've received an incredible amount of support from players! During Steam Next Fest, the game ranked #1 in player count, with over 600,000 players having played the Demo! A huge thank-you to everyone who joined the class and got up to all kinds of mischief, as well as all the teachers who tried their best to keep things under control (even if classroom discipline wasn't exactly ideal).Although the Demo classroom is about to close its doors, the real fun is only just beginning! The full release will bring even more classrooms, a brand-new female homeroom teacher, more prank items, support for up to 8 players, and plenty of other exciting content. Get ready for an even bigger battle of wits between teachers and students!Class officially starts on November 10! Haven't added the game to your wishlist yet? Be sure to do so! See you in class!

newsitems.title: [School-Wide Announcement] Coming Nov 10! — #1 in Steam Next Fest Player Count!
newsitems.author: heye
newsitems.contents: Dear Teachers and Students,Worst Class Ever is officially launching on November 10!The Demo ranked #1 in player count during the Steam Next Fest, with over 600,000 players having played the game so far! A huge thank-you to all the students and teachers for your enthusiastic support! The full game is almost here. Are you ready for another round of classroom chaos?The full release will bring even more fun and mischief, including:A brand-new Female Homeroom Teacher characterUp to 10 unique classroom themesAn increased player limit of 8 players per matchCustomizable rooms, with up to 20 settings to tweak, including player count, number of teachers, and item spawn ratesEven more prank itemsSmoother server performance and LAN mode supportThere are plenty of new tricks and surprises waiting for you! Round up your classmates and troublemaking buddies, and get ready for an epic battle of wits between teachers and students. Will the students outsmart the teachers, or will the teachers keep the class under control? There's only one way to find out!Class starts on November 10! Haven't added the game to your wishlist yet? Be sure to do so before the bell rings. See you in class!

newsitems.title: [School-Wide Announcement]300K Reached in 10 Days! Computer Lab out now!
newsitems.author: 夜之黄泉
newsitems.contents: Dear teachers and students,Hello everyone! We are thrilled to share some exciting news with you once again.It has been 10 days since the launch of Worst Class Ever Demo, and the player count has surpassed 300,000! We’ve also claimed the #1 spot for the most popular demo during the Steam Next Fest!This achievement would not have been possible without every one of you supporting us. Every time you launch the game and every piece of feedback you send has helped us reach this milestone.To show our gratitude, we have just released a brand-new update with upgraded gameplay! The Computer Lab on the 4th floor is now open. Students sneak games during computer class — can the teacher catch them?We’ve also adjusted the gameplay based on recent community feedback:Student players can now leave their seats while holding items.NPC student AI has been expanded, giving them more varied behaviors after leaving their seats.Spacing between wooden pillars has been increased to reduce overcrowding.Fixed an issue where players could fall out of the classroom.Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck on certain steps.Thank you again for all your support! We will keep fixing issues and making improvements based on your feedback, and we’re working hard to add more fun content. If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to add it to your Wishlist on the Steam store page!Have fun playing!

newsitems.title: [School-Wide Announcement]200K Reached in 7 Days! New Gameplay Update Complete
newsitems.author: 夜之黄泉
newsitems.contents: Dear teachers and students, hello everyone!We are excited to announce that, 7 days after the release of "The Worst Class I Ever Had" Demo, the number of players has exceeded 200,000!To thank everyone for their support, we have combined community feedback and launched a new round of gameplay upgrades!1. Gameplay Experience UpdatesCrawling Forward: Students can now crawl forward and sneak between desks and chairs to avoid being caught by teachers;Slipping Out the Back Door: All classroom back doors can be opened, but be careful not to be discovered by teachers;Teacher's Lunch: Teacher's lunch is hidden in the office. Is it a gift from the heavens or a trap set by the teacher?Teacher's Rage: Human Wave Tactics? Now, every time you capture a mischievous student, you will gain extra stamina. As long as you aim accurately with the chalk, you will never be caught off guard again!2. Scene and Sound Effects OptimizationOptimized lighting in the lecture hall, re-baked some lighting effects;Adjusted classroom desks and chairs, teacher's desk, class sign, and some scene layouts;Added sound effects for stepping on bananas and slipping;Added sound effects for teachers writing on the blackboard.3. Bug FixesFixed the issue where the animation did not reset correctly after a student was caught and put down by a teacher;Fixed the issue where interaction was still possible when caught or tied up;Fixed the issue where switching to teacher identity at the beginning of class caused role assignment and teleportation anomalies;Fixed the issue where some books on the second floor appeared blackened; Fixed the issue of getting stuck and unable to pass in the lecture hall;Fixed the issue of lacking prompts after client disconnection, and returning to the login interface after confirming the prompt.We will continue to make repairs and optimizations based on everyone's feedback, and will also strive to add more interesting gameplay elements!Thank you again for your support!If you like our game, don't forget to add it to your \ on the Steam store page!Wish you all a happy gaming experience!

newsitems.title: Worst Class Ever Demo 0.1.9 Update Announcement
newsitems.author: heye
newsitems.contents: Worst Class Ever Demo 0.1.9 Update AnnouncementDear Teachers and Students,Hello everyone! The new build has been released. This update focuses on improving online connection stability, balancing matches between teachers and students, and fixing various odd issues.Changelog as follows:1. Server & Online ImprovementsWhen there are fewer students: reduce the number of Mischief Points required to win;When there are more students: allow the teacher to recover some stamina after catching students;Item spawning: dynamically adjust spawn probabilities based on the number of students.2. Experience ImprovementsAdded campus ambient sound effects;Added sound effects for eating and drinking.3. Bug FixesFixed an issue where players could occasionally get stuck on the loading progress bar when joining a public room;Fixed an issue where the teacher’s feet could get stuck when moving on the podium;Fixed an issue where the ESC key could not close the lobby screen;Fixed an issue where rooms with 0/6 players could appear in the public room list.We will keep refining the game based on your feedback. Thank you for your support, teachers and students! If you enjoy our game, don’t forget to add it to your Wishlist on the Steam store page!Have fun playing!

newsitems.title: Worst Class Ever Demo 0.1.7 Update Announcement

newsitems.contents: Worst Class Ever Demo 0.1.7 Update AnnouncementDear Teachers and Students,Hello everyone! The new build has been released. Thank you for your support, teachers and students! If you enjoy our game, don’t forget to add it to your Wishlist on the Steam store page!Have fun playing!

newsitems.title: Demo 0.1.6 Update Announcement
newsitems.author: 夜之黄泉
newsitems.contents: Worst Class Ever – Demo Update AnnouncementDear Teachers and Students,Hello everyone!Thank you all for your support of the Worst Class Ever Demo! Over the past few days, we've received a lot of suggestions and bug reports, and our team has been working hard to fix issues and improve the game.We've just released a new update, focusing on server performance, multiplayer stability, and various bug fixes.Here are the details:1. Server & Multiplayer ImprovementsExpanded server capacity and optimized performance to reduce disconnections and lag;Fixed an issue where player characters remained in the game after players disconnected;Fixed an issue where players sometimes couldn't hear others in voice chat after joining a game;Fixed incorrect error codes being displayed when failing to join a room.2. New Features & ImprovementsAdded the ability to invite Steam friends through the in-game phone;Added notifications when elevators become available;Added Steam profile pictures to the results screen;Improved lighting on the second floor;Reduced waiting time after matches end;Player characters now reset to their student appearance when returning to the hallway.3. Bug FixesFixed an issue where players could get stuck inside lockers;Fixed an issue where chalk sometimes failed to hit students;Fixed an issue where phones could continue ringing after players left their seats.4. Balance AdjustmentsIncreased the time required to rescue captured students when more students are in the match;Reduced the spawn rate of special items.We'll continue fixing issues and improving the game based on your feedback. Thank you again for all your support!If you're enjoying the game, don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist!Have fun, and enjoy your classes!

newsitems.title: [School-Wide Announcement] 10,000+ Players on Day 1! Emergency Repairs Completed
newsitems.author: 夜之黄泉
newsitems.contents: Dear Teachers and Students,Hello everyone!We honestly never expected this—just yesterday, on our very first day of the Demo launch, over 10,000+ players downloaded and hopped into the game!Seeing the dashboard stats blew our minds; the entire dev team was both thrilled and incredibly humbled. A huge, heartfelt thank you to everyone who gave the demo a spin and showed us love! At the same time, we received a mountain of constructive feedback, hilarious critiques, and bug reports. We know the game is far from perfect right now, and we are diligently logging every single issue to roll out fixes as fast as we can.We have just pushed the Demo 0.1.4 update. Here are the fixes and optimizations included:Optimized the loading and refresh speed of the "Room List";Improved the onboarding tutorial and updated localization/translations;Optimized code performance and addressed several random crashing issues;Fixed a bug where matches might not end after all students were caught;Fixed an issue where the loading progress bar could freeze when joining a room;Fixed a bug where classroom desks and chairs occasionally failed to load after class started;Fixed an issue where custom keybinds might randomly reset or fail to apply;Fixed a bug causing players to unexpectedly teleport or spawn on different floors;Fixed an issue where volume slider adjustments sometimes did not take effect.We will keep polishing and pushing frequent updates based on your feedback to ensure your multiplayer experience gets smoother and smoother!If you're having fun with the game, please don't forget to add the full game to your Steam Wishlist! Every single wishlist gives our small indie team a massive boost to make the final release the best it can be.Thank you all, and have fun playing!
